A '''mansion''' served as the home of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], following their [[Confrontation on Ambria|escape]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in [[990 BBY]]. In [[980 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] hired the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Darth Cognus|Huntress]] and a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to capture Bane, as she believed he had killed [[Caleb|her father]]. They arrived at Bane's mansion while he was returning from a [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|mission]] to [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]], [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|ambushed]] him upon his return, and brought him to Serra.
